lines.en: Sssss, here I come.
Chill runs through you, beware.
Frost-covered, proceed with caution.
Frost cracks, watch your step.
In the night, I am sharper.
Cold seeps in, you can't escape.
Ice hides danger beneath.
In the cold, I am stronger.
Source of cold, I am fear.
In the frozen earth, darkness spreads.

lines.zh: 触须扫过冰面，留下符文。
lines.en: My tendrils sweep the ice and leave runes.

lines.zh: 我贴着冻土滑行，悄无声息。
lines.en: I glide along the frozen soil without a sound.

lines.zh: 冰寒凝视，感受我的力量。
lines.en: Glacial stare, feel my power.
Heart of ice, unchanging.
Cold gaze, freezes all.
Chill swirls, follows you.
In ice and snow, I wait.
Cold breeze, I approach.
Cold breath, death's herald.
Frozen world, I alone.
Icy grip, clutches fate.
Cold's origin, my power.
Beak half open, I breathe out frost.
Arcane motes circle slowly around me.

lines.zh: 我把热量一点点吸进体内。
lines.en: I draw the warmth in, bit by bit.
Tendrils coiled in the dark, I feign sleep.

lines.zh: 你动了，感受到我的气息吗？
lines.en: You moved, feel my presence?
Prey's scent, near now.
Your movements, triggered alert.
Tracking target, nearby.
Your existence, icy chill.
Feel me? I'm here.
Your voice, I hear it.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，都在我眼中。
lines.en: Your every move, in my sight.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，逃不过我。
lines.en: You can't escape my sight.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，都在我掌握中。
lines.en: Your every action, in my grasp.

lines.zh: 你呵出的白气，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the white breath you exhale.

lines.zh: 你的体温，像火把一样亮。
lines.en: Your body heat glows like a torch.
Don't tap your foot; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 你身上的符文，和我同源。
lines.en: The runes on you come from the same source as mine.
Come closer and frost will crawl over your boots.

lines.zh: 我歪过头，打量你的影子。
lines.en: I tilt my head and study your shadow.
That torch of yours is feeding me.
Don't blink; my tendrils are quick.
Pain rages within me!
My frost scatters. I shake hard.
Stop the attack, please!
The arcane light is nearly out.

lines.zh: 奥术的光，从我指缝漏走了。
lines.en: Arcane light leaks between my fingers.
My arcane is leaking; I need to refill.
Enough pain!
I can't take it anymore!
Please don't hurt me!
Please save me!

lines.zh: 它的触角触碰着你，魔力涌动的声音让你颤抖。
lines.en: Its tentacles touch you, causing your body to tremble with magical sounds.

lines.zh: 你看见它的双眼中燃烧着奥术之火。
lines.en: You see the arcane flames burning in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它的声音低沉而富有魔力。
lines.en: Its voice is deep and magical.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在你身上留下了奇怪的符文印记。
lines.en: Its claws leave strange rune marks on your body.

lines.zh: 奥术闪在黑暗中缓缓移动，魔力凝聚成实体。
lines.en: Skyre moves slowly in the darkness, magic coalescing into a实体.

lines.zh: 它的嘶嘶声在耳畔回荡，令人不寒而栗。
lines.en: Its hiss echoes in your ears, making you shiver.

lines.zh: 它的长喙中喷出一缕奥术烟雾。
lines.en: A puff of arcane smoke comes from its long beak.

lines.zh: 我眼里的奥术光，你在看？
lines.en: That arcane glow in my eyes — you see it?

lines.zh: 魔力在它的皮肤上形成奇特的图案。
lines.en: Magic forms strange patterns on its skin.

lines.zh: 它的影子在墙上投下扭曲的光环。
lines.en: Its shadow casts a twisted halo on the wall.

lines.zh: 你的撞击让奥术闪的魔力波动。
lines.en: Your impact ripples through Skyre's magic.

lines.zh: 你和奥术闪的触角碰撞，魔法火花四溅。
lines.en: Your tentacles clash with Skyre's, sending magical sparks flying.
It uses magic to repel you.

lines.zh: 你们的碰撞使得魔力涌动。
lines.en: Your collision causes a surge of magic.

lines.zh: 奥术闪试图用触角缠绕住你。
lines.en: Skyre tries to ensnare you with its tentacles.

lines.zh: 你的撞击使其发出惊人的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Your impact makes it hiss with surprise.

lines.zh: 你们的碰撞使得地面上裂开一道裂缝。
lines.en: Your collision causes a fissure to crack in the ground.

lines.zh: 奥术闪的魔力波动影响到你。
lines.en: Skyre's magic affects you.

lines.zh: 碰撞后，奥术闪留下了一道符文。
lines.en: After the collision, Skyre leaves a rune.

lines.zh: 它的触角缠绕在你的身上，魔力包围了你。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around you, magic enveloping you.

lines.zh: 它寻找着可以交配的伴侣。
lines.en: It searches for a mate.

lines.zh: 奥术闪发出求偶的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Skyre hisses in courtship.

lines.zh: 它用触角轻轻触碰对方。
lines.en: It gently touches its mate with its tentacles.

lines.zh: 奥术闪在交配时散发出微光。
lines.en: Skyre glows softly during mating.

lines.zh: 它眼中闪烁着交配的欲望。
lines.en: Desire flickers in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它们交配时，奥术烟雾缭绕。
lines.en: Arcane smoke surrounds them during mating.

lines.zh: 奥术闪在交配时发出低沉的声音。
lines.en: It makes deep sounds during mating.

lines.zh: 它们在交配时彼此靠近。
lines.en: They approach each other during mating.

lines.zh: 奥术闪的交配留下了特殊的印记。
lines.en: Mating leaves special marks on them.

lines.zh: 它们在交配时发出奇异的光芒。
lines.en: They emit strange light during mating.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，我吞下你的热量。
lines.en: Sibilant intake, your warmth is mine.

lines.zh: 吞噬吧，这将是你的末日。
lines.en: Devour, this is your end.
Your energy feeds me.
Sense and consume!
Energy, I need energy.
You cannot escape my tendrils.
Consume all, until death.
Your pain, my sustenance.
Absorb your life, nourish me.

lines.zh: 你只是我餐桌上的一道菜。
lines.en: You're just a dish on my table.
I've found you, ready to devour.
Target locked, about to devour.
Run. The ice will keep your marks.
I can smell your fear.
You'll be my nutrient.
Devour target, prepare to eat.
You're within my reach.
You'll become part of me.
Devour you, enjoy the taste.
You're my next meal.
Source of heat — found you.
Tendrils straighten; I fix my bearing.

lines.zh: 你身上的暖意，太显眼了。
lines.en: The warmth in you is far too obvious.
The ice cracks; I give chase.
Tonight I drain a little fire.
Step into the frost ring and you're mine.

lines.zh: 你的位置已知，等待时机。
lines.en: Your position is known, waiting for an opportunity.
Locked and ready to devour.
One step closer and my tentacles reach.
My tendrils will touch you.
You're too close.
The ice walls close. The path narrows.
I'm coming, nowhere to hide.
Come closer, closer still.
My tendrils will wrap around you.

lines.zh: 蓝光一闪，我已经在你背后。
lines.en: One blue flash, and I am behind you.

lines.zh: 我的长喙对准你的胸口。
lines.en: My long beak aims at your chest.
A rune lights up: you are marked.
Don't back away; there's an ice wall behind you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸越来越急，很好。
lines.en: Your breathing quickens. Good.
I gather the frost at my beak's tip.
My tendrils split three ways and close around you.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也快不过光。
lines.en: Run as you might, you can't outrun light.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳在结冰。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat frosting over.
Sssss, here it comes!
Avoid its sharp claws!
Watch out for its magical tentacles!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着奥术能量！
lines.en: Its eyes glow with arcane energy!
Its tail curls, coming at you!

lines.zh: 它的爪子比黑暗还要冷！
lines.en: Its claws are colder than darkness!
Avoid its ambush!

lines.zh: 它的身体发出诡异的光芒！
lines.en: Its body emits eerie light!

lines.zh: 它的攻击令人难以招架！
lines.en: Its attacks are hard to parry!
Quickly attack its weak spot!
A tendril lashes your arm!
The beak strikes, trailing cold!
This rip takes even your warmth!
Frost blades reach out from my shadow!
Arcane force bursts; you're thrown back!

lines.zh: 我的爪子掠过你的脖颈！
lines.en: My claws graze your neck!
At night, the Skyre appears!
It emerges from the darkness!

lines.zh: 天空中飘来一团黑雾，它出现了！
lines.en: A dark fog appears in the sky, and it's here!
The Skyre wanders in the shadows!
Its spawn egg hatches!
It lurks in the ruins!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的光芒，是它的身影！
lines.en: A light in the darkness, its silhouette!

lines.zh: 它的存在让夜晚更加阴森！
lines.en: Its presence makes the night even more eerie!
It crawls out of the cracks!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的阴影，是它的化身！
lines.en: The shadow in the darkness, its incarnation!
The frozen ground splits; I rise from it.
Frost gathers into my outline.

lines.zh: 符文圈闪了一下，我来了。
lines.en: The rune circle flares once — I'm here.
The night wind suddenly stops.

lines.zh: 我从冰缝里缓缓抽出触须。
lines.en: I draw my tendrils slowly from the ice crack.
The magic thickens and I take shape.

lines.zh: 洞顶垂下霜，我悬在那儿。
lines.en: Frost hangs from the roof; I wait there.

lines.zh: 寒气多了一分，我便到了。
lines.en: The cold deepens by one degree, and I arrive.
Fire baked the frost out of me.
The ice step broke. I fell.
I'm drowning!
Explosion tears my body!
Arrow pierces my flesh!

lines.zh: 魔法能量摧毁了我的肉体！
lines.en: Magic destroys my body!
Starvation consumes me!
Lightning tears my flesh!
Void rips my existence!
